scope: Local estimate in GRAND-Smeta OpenXML format; not GGE, not GSFX signature/container specification

elements.APositionInfo/@Quantity: string: expanded physical-volume formula or number; not globally numeric-only
elements.APositionInfo/@SysID: stable internal position number; not changed by display renumbering or movement
elements.MaxSysID: maximum position SysID, not position count
elements.NotCountedResSysID: reference to source unaccounted resource; appears on positions/resources
elements.TResourseOptions/NotCount: unaccounted resource option; inspect containing type in XSD

limitations: Schema validity alone does not verify formula calculation or statutory applicability.
No private project data is included.
Gsfx Data.sign cryptographic semantics are outside this schema.
